edits.old: The probes are cluster-internal and are not part of the API surface.
edits.new:
The probes are cluster-internal and are not part of the API surface.

The release builds against version v1 of the contract baseline RWB-P10-E1063-CON, as the `/v1` API surface and the `.v1` schema of EV-28 both carry (DOR-RWB-P10-E1063-OPS-23). The aggregate of a business date is computed and served by rwb-agent from its own `agent_run` and `agent_evaluation` rows in `rwb_agent`, and the count check of the legacy AC3 holds on it (GAP-0616; DP-17). The aggregate element carries, per agent and business date, the runs, the answered count, the fallback count, the fallback rate at four decimals, the latency p50 and p95, the tokens, the cost and the latest evaluation score, and the held-date status carries the business date, the run state and the previous published date (GAP-0617). The page size, the cursor form, the maximum page and the member types of the answer are declared by RWB-P10-E1063-CON and are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0617).

edits.old: The target is the legacy measure: the aggregate of a business date available before the officers start, and the cost alert sent within 15 minutes of the end of the rollup (DL11).
edits.new: The target is the legacy measure: the aggregate of a business date available before the officers start, and the cost alert sent within 15 minutes of the end of the rollup (DL11). DL11 stays open: its four assumptions ASM-0553, ASM-0703, ASM-1051 and ASM-1104 are confirmed by the programme directive (D-RCV-60), no decision outcome is recorded, and the story continues in Draft status (DOR-RWB-P10-E1063-OPS-18).

edits.old: No operation of rwb-integration is deployed here: the delivery beyond rwb-comms is RWB-P2-E1007-CON and belongs to the communications release.
edits.new:
No operation of rwb-integration is deployed here: the delivery beyond rwb-comms is RWB-P2-E1007-CON and belongs to the communications release.

The dashboard measures are the P9 reporting read model of RWB-P9-E1063-APP, fed from `rwb.agent.AgentRunCompleted.v1` and the P10 daily step and read through `GET /api/recovery/reporting/v1/reports/measures`; the count check of the legacy AC3 and the cost alert rule hold on that read model, and no lake copy and no Power BI feed remain (GAP-0372; DP-17). JOB-15 stays the 01:30 reporting trigger owned by P9 rwb-reporting, and its rerun by business date is read through the admin job operations of P1 rwb-source-data, whose path is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0372).
